regime_context: The detector shows a broad, non-dominant rotation: Memory/HBM leads on momentum but with weak durability (0.43) and fading breadth (0.0), while Silver and Gold Miners sit just behind with much stronger durability and full breadth. The only validated edge here is the absolute-trend gate for drawdown control, so any lean must be humble and expressed as a conditional, not a prediction.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Memory/HBM's fading breadth (0.0) and low durability (0.43) begin to improve while Silver Miners hold full breadth — a confirmed handoff where Silver Miners overtake Memory on score AND sustain breadth would retire this watch; until then, Memory's lead is flagged but not faded.

theses.subject: Silver Miners
theses.thesis: Silver Miners rank #2 with a strong durability bar (0.79) and full breadth (1.0), suggesting the trend is broadly held across constituents. It is eligible under the absolute-trend gate and not crowded, so it clears the one leg with validated risk-control value. The lean is a trend-continuation tilt, not a return forecast.
theses.dissent: Silver miners are highly volatile and sensitive to industrial-demand shocks; the detector's momentum rank has no forward alpha, so this is a structural/durability read with no predictive edge.

falsifier.text: SIL breaks below its 50-day moving average and breadth drops under 0.5 before the check-by date

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners rank #3 with the strongest durability profile in the top tier (0.81) and a trend hurst tag, plus full breadth (1.0). It is eligible and uncrowded. The trend-gate leg is the supporting factor; the lean is a modest continuation tilt rather than a forecast of leadership.
theses.dissent: Gold miners are hostage to real rates and dollar moves; if risk appetite returns strongly, defensive metals could lag the broad rotation that is currently favoring semiconductors.

falsifier.text: GDX lags the S&P 500 by 5% over the next 20 trading days despite the trend gate remaining eligible

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity ranks #5 with strong durability (0.87) and full breadth, but it is crowded (crowding_z 1.88). Crowding is a size-down caution only, never a sell, so the lean is avoidance rather than a fade. The crowding leg is the sole basis for this avoid.
theses.dissent: Strong durability and full breadth suggest a resilient trend; crowding flags have no basket-level forward edge and may simply reflect sustained institutional demand.

falsifier.text: CIBR decrowds (crowding_z drops below 1.0) while breadth stays above 0.8 before the check-by date
